nodes.label: Netherite Block Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style netherite block texture. Very dark charcoal/near-black surface with subtle pixel noise and faint lighter flecks suggesting the blended ancient debris composite material. Color palette: very dark grey-black (#1A1A1A to #2A2A2A) with muted brownish-grey undertones and occasional lighter pixel highlights. Game purpose: storage block for netherite ingots, the rarest and most durable crafting material; used as prestige building block and upgrade material for diamond gear.
nodes.pattern: nearly uniform dark surface with subtle pixel noise and faint grey flecks
